name: Swarm of Venomous Snakes

source.note: The 2024 Swarm of Venomous Snakes (2025 Monster Manual). Every number compared with the page fetched from aidedd.org (Monster Manual 2024 stat block).

traits.name: Swarm
traits.summary: Shares spaces with other creatures and fits through snake-sized gaps; can't heal or gain Temporary Hit Points.
traits.text: The swarm can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and it can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. It can't regain Hit Points or gain Temporary Hit Points.

actions.name: Bites

damage.when: instead, while the swarm is Bloodied

actions.summary: Many venomous bites; the piercing part drops once the swarm is Bloodied.

summary: A writhing swarm of snakes that bites with venom and resists weapon damage.
